prompt: Declan promised (to return) my camping lamp before the weekend trip.
explanation_ru: После глагола promise в косвенной речи ставится инфинитив с частицей to (promised to return).

prompt: Didn't Priya suggest (to rest) by the lake after our walk?
explanation_ru: После глагола suggest используется герундий (-ing), а не инфинитив с to: suggest resting.

prompt: Marek texted me and apologised (to miss) my evening phone call.
explanation_ru: Глагол apologise требует предлога for и герундия: apologised for missing.

prompt: Two years ago, Lucia mentioned (she / to enjoy) her bookshop job and offered (to train) me.
explanation_ru: Глагол mention вводит придаточное с союзом that (его можно опустить) и сдвигом времени в Past Simple, а после offer всегда идёт инфинитив с to.

prompt: Tunde admitted (to crack) my favourite blue teapot, and he promised (to replace) it before Sunday.
explanation_ru: После admit используется герундий (cracking / having cracked), а после promise — инфинитив с частицей to (to replace).

prompt: The buses weren't running, so Wei suggested (to share) a cab, though Tariq refused (to split) the fare.
explanation_ru: Глагол suggest требует герундия (sharing), тогда как после refuse всегда ставится инфинитив с to (to split).

prompt: Oksana burst into the hall by mistake, immediately apologised (to interrupt) the choir practice, and insisted (to tidy) the chairs afterwards as a favour.
explanation_ru: Оба глагола требуют предлога и герундия: apologise for + -ing и insist on + -ing.

prompt: Nobody saw what happened to the hall mirror, and while Gareth denied (to scratch) the frame, our landlord still accused him (to move) the heavy shelf alone.
explanation_ru: После deny ставится герундий без предлога (scratching), а конструкция accuse somebody требует предлога of и герундия (of moving).

prompt: Our manager looked worried before the annual staff dinner. Sora promised (to finish) the table chart before five so the hotel could print the cards. When she noticed two missing guests, she apologised (to mix) up the lists and suggested (to add) an extra round table. In the end, everyone had a seat and enjoyed the meal.
explanation_ru: Каждый глагол задаёт свою модель: promise + to-infinitive, apologise + for + -ing, suggest + -ing.

prompt: Moving day turned out to be much harder than I expected. Piotr suggested (to hire) a smaller van because the lane outside my new flat was very narrow. At first the driver refused (to drive) past the corner, so we had to unload early. Luckily, my cousin insisted (to carry) the heaviest boxes himself.
explanation_ru: После suggest нужен герундий (hiring), после refuse — инфинитив с to (to drive), а после insist — предлог on и герундий (on carrying).

prompt: Rain poured against the kitchen window all evening, and none of us felt like going out. Nadia suggested (to cook) vegetable curry together instead of buying fast food. Her flatmate agreed (to chop) the onions, although he admitted (to burn) the rice the week before. Even so, the meal tasted great.
explanation_ru: Глаголы suggest и admit требуют герундия (cooking, burning), а agree — инфинитива с частицей to (to chop).

prompt: Eleni walked into the living room with a huge bunch of yellow tulips and a guilty smile. She immediately apologised (to forget) her sister's birthday, explaining that her phone calendar had stopped syncing. Her brother teased her, though she firmly denied (to ignore) his reminder message on purpose. To make up for it, she promised (to bake) a chocolate cake at the weekend and insisted (to pay) for the family cinema tickets. Her sister laughed and forgave her straight away.
explanation_ru: Здесь сочетаются четыре модели: apologise for + -ing, deny + -ing, promise + to-infinitive и insist on + -ing.

prompt: Thick snow blocked the main road into Leeds, leaving half the college students stranded at their bus stops. Our tutor suggested (to hold) the morning seminar online rather than cancelling it completely. One student explained (he / not / to own) a webcam, so the IT helper advised him (to restart) the browser on his phone instead. Meanwhile, the department head warned us (not / to upload) large videos during the live call. By ten o'clock, everyone had joined the screen and the debate began.
explanation_ru: После suggest идёт герундий, после explain — придаточное с that и сдвигом в Past Simple, а после advise/warn + дополнение — инфинитив с (not) to.

prompt: The sun came out, so Chidi suggested ___ in the park.
explanation_ru: После глагола suggest нужен герундий (-ing): suggested having lunch. Типичная ошибка — ставить инфинитив с to (suggest to have).

prompt: Did Rohan apologise ___ twenty minutes late for the client meeting this morning?
explanation_ru: Глагол apologise требует предлога for и формы с -ing (apologise for arriving). Русскоязычные часто ошибочно ставят инфинитив (to arrive) или союз that.

prompt: Parking fees in the centre had doubled, so Fiona recommended taking the tram, though her uncle ___ his diesel car at home.
explanation_ru: После глагола refuse используется только инфинитив с to (refused to leave). Ошибки — ставить герундий (refused leaving) или придаточное с that.

prompt: Mateo suggested to visit the street market for fresh fruit.
answer: Mateo suggested visiting the street market for fresh fruit.
accepted_answers: Mateo suggested visiting the street market for fresh fruit.
Mateo suggested that we visit the street market for fresh fruit.
Mateo suggested that we visited the street market for fresh fruit.
Mateo suggested that we should visit the street market for fresh fruit.
explanation_ru: Глагол suggest не употребляется с инфинитивом (to visit) — после него нужен герундий: suggested visiting.

prompt: Zainab promised to post the signed rental form before the office closed on Friday.
answer: Zainab promised to post the signed rental form before the office closed on Friday.
accepted_answers: Zainab promised to post the signed rental form before the office closed on Friday.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: после глагола promise верно использован инфинитив с to (promised to post), а в придаточном соблюдено согласование времён (closed).

prompt: While we were away in Glasgow, our neighbour Daria promised to water the balcony herbs, though she later denied to forget them during the heatwave.
answer: While we were away in Glasgow, our neighbour Daria promised to water the balcony herbs, though she later denied forgetting them during the heatwave.
accepted_answers: While we were away in Glasgow, our neighbour Daria promised to water the balcony herbs, though she later denied forgetting them during the heatwave.
While we were away in Glasgow, our neighbour Daria promised to water the balcony herbs, though she later denied having forgotten them during the heatwave.
explanation_ru: После глагола deny требуется герундий (denied forgetting / having forgotten), а не инфинитив с to — это частая ошибка русскоязычных учащихся.

prompt: Samir looked at the cafe menu and told his friends, “Why don't we order the roasted pepper pie instead of burgers?” Which sentence reports this correctly?
options: Samir ordered his friends to eat the roasted pepper pie.
Samir promised to order the roasted pepper pie for everyone.
Samir suggested to order the roasted pepper pie instead of burgers.
Samir suggested ordering the roasted pepper pie instead of burgers.
explanation_ru: Фраза «Why don't we...» выражает предложение, которое передаётся через suggest + герундий (suggested ordering). Вариант с to order грамматически неверен, а ordered и promised искажают смысл.

prompt: My sister told the driver, “I live near the port.” → My sister mentioned …
answer: My sister mentioned that she lived near the port.
accepted_answers: My sister mentioned that she lived near the port.
My sister mentioned she lived near the port.
My sister mentioned that she lives near the port.
My sister mentioned she lives near the port.
explanation_ru: Глагол mention вводит придаточное с союзом that (его можно опустить), местоимение I меняется на she, а глагол обычно сдвигается в Past Simple (lived).
